mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a labor market adjustment that reduces risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not cross 4.5% threshold within the month, or 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and demand for housing (HOUST) signal robust economic activity, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in tandem, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (monetary easing) reduces borrowing costs, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The federal funds rate does not decline in the late-cycle regime, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index above 102 signals stronger supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The industrial production index does not exceed 102, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in the unemployment rate below 4.8% and labor demand (PAYEMS) indicate improving labor market conditions, reducing risk aversion and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in tandem, or 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) reflects robust economic growth, which lowers discount rates on future earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The quarterly GDP trend reverses, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate (monetary easing) and industrial production (supply growth) reduce uncertainty and boost equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not met, or the proxies do not move in tandem (FEDFUNDS up while INDPRO up), or 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
